title: An SCP on an OU in an organization
claim: An SCP on an organizational unit limits every member account below it, but not the management account.
alt: An organization tree. The root holds the management account and two OUs, Security and Workloads. An SCP is attached to the Workloads OU and reaches its dev and prod accounts only.

edges.say: Organizational units (OUs) group the member accounts under the root of the organization.

edges.label: attached
edges.say: An SCP attached to the Workloads OU applies to every account in that OU.

edges.label: must also allow
edges.say: An SCP never grants permissions, so the IAM policies in prod must also allow the request.

edges.label: no SCP effect
edges.say: SCPs do not restrict users or roles in the management account.

notes: Brief 04 hero, 1-fast.md#in-one-breath. Claim, alt, steps from brief.json. Generic accounts. A tree of nodes, because each step needs an arrow.
